endo-exo-energy-flow.alt: Two panels comparing exothermic and endothermic processes. In each, the system (the reacting particles) sits inside the surroundings (water, cup, air). Exothermic: energy arrows point out of the system, the thermometer in the surroundings rises, ΔH is negative. Endothermic: arrows point into the system, the thermometer falls, ΔH is positive.
